shots.intent: The pain: a great clip, then two hours lost
shots.description: Camera viewfinder REC with a check on 'clip'; hard cut to a timeline piling up clips, a clock spins to 2 HOURS, everything falls away

shots.intent: The new way is one message
shots.description: A phone chat: a video bubble flies in on 'Send', uploads, lands with a check; THAT'S IT stamps

shots.intent: Every word transcribed, dead air cut
shots.description: Pencil sketchbook: transcript words written on lines, a waveform drawn in pencil, its flat gap circled red and snipped out
A viewfinder on a speaker silhouette punches in with a selection box and a x1.3 tag; POINT slams

shots.intent: Captions locked to words, logos on cue
shots.description: Design-tool artboard: caption chips land one per word with a LOCKED selection box; three app-logo tiles pop in on 'pop'

shots.intent: Music that survives a phone speaker
shots.description: Phone speaker grille with live EQ bars: sub bars fade grey under a 150 Hz line, the mids glow; HEARD tag lands
Kinetic poster: NO TIMELINE / NO CAPCUT / NO LAPTOP, each struck through, grounds hard-cut
A comment card types EDIT, sends, a heart bursts and a reply chip says the whole setup is on its way
